problem_dimensions.num_zones: <int> Number of spatial zones in the power system network.
problem_dimensions.num_weeks: <int> Number of representative weeks modeled in the planning year.
problem_dimensions.hours_per_week: <int> Number of hourly time steps within each representative week.
problem_dimensions.total_timesteps: <int> Total number of hourly time steps across all weeks (num_weeks * hours_per_week).
problem_dimensions.num_generators: <int> Total number of resource clusters (generators, storage, and hydro) across all zones.
problem_dimensions.num_UC_generators: <int> Number of resource clusters subject to unit commitment (thermal plants with discrete startup/shutdown).
problem_dimensions.num_storage_resources: <int> Number of battery storage resource clusters across all zones.
problem_dimensions.num_hydro_resources: <int> Number of reservoir-based hydropower resource clusters across all zones.
problem_dimensions.num_transmission_lines: <int> Number of interregional transmission lines connecting zones.
problem_dimensions.num_demand_segments: <int> Number of non-served energy penalty cost segments for demand curtailment.

policy.RPS_enabled: <bool> Whether the renewable portfolio standard policy is active.
policy.RPS_share: <float> Required fraction of total weighted demand that must come from RPS-qualifying resources.
policy.CO2_cap_enabled: <bool> Whether the CO2 emissions cap policy is active.
policy.CO2_cap_tons_per_MWh: <float or null> CO2 emissions cap expressed as tons per MWh of total weighted demand, null if policy is inactive.
policy.RPS_noncompliance_cost_per_MWh: <float> Penalty cost per MWh of shortfall below the RPS requirement.
policy.CO2_noncompliance_cost_per_ton: <float> Penalty cost per ton of CO2 exceeding the emissions cap.

subperiods.num_subperiods: <int> Number of representative weekly subperiods in the planning year.
subperiods.hours_per_subperiod: <int> Number of hourly time steps within each subperiod.
subperiods.subperiod_weights: <list[float], length num_subperiods> Number of weeks each subperiod represents when annualizing costs and quantities.
subperiods.circular_indexing: <bool> Whether the first and last hours of each subperiod are linked circularly for state-of-charge, reservoir, and ramping constraints.

generators.id: <int> Unique identifier for this resource cluster.
generators.zone: <int> Zone in which this resource cluster is located.
generators.resource_type: <str> Technology type of the resource (e.g., onshore_wind, solar_pv, ng_cc, battery_4hr, hydro).
generators.category: <str> Resource category: VRE, THERMAL, STORAGE, or HYDRO.
generators.is_UC: <bool> Whether this resource is subject to unit commitment constraints.
generators.is_storage: <bool> Whether this resource is a battery storage resource.
generators.is_hydro: <bool> Whether this resource is a reservoir-based hydropower resource.
generators.is_RPS_qualifying: <bool> Whether generation from this resource counts toward the renewable portfolio standard.
generators.can_retire: <bool> Whether existing capacity of this resource may be retired.
generators.capacity_size_MW: <float> Power capacity per discrete unit in MW, used for integer investment and unit commitment sizing.
generators.existing_capacity_MW: <float> Currently installed power capacity in MW before any new investment or retirement.
generators.max_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum total power capacity in MW that this resource cluster may reach after investment.
generators.inv_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized investment cost per MW of new power capacity.
generators.fom_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annual fixed operations and maintenance cost per MW of total installed power capacity.
generators.var_cost_per_MWh: <float> Variable operating cost per MWh of generation or storage withdrawal.
generators.co2_tons_per_MWh: <float> CO2 emissions intensity in tons per MWh of generation.
generators.min_output_frac: <float> Minimum generation as a fraction of committed capacity (UC resources) or installed capacity (non-UC resources).
generators.ramp_up_frac_per_hr: <float> Maximum hourly increase in generation as a fraction of capacity (present for non-storage resources).
generators.ramp_dn_frac_per_hr: <float> Maximum hourly decrease in generation as a fraction of capacity (present for non-storage resources).
generators.min_up_time_hr: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours a unit must remain online after starting up (UC resources only).
generators.min_down_time_hr: <int> Minimum number of consecutive hours a unit must remain offline after shutting down (UC resources only).
generators.start_cost_per_unit: <float> Cost incurred each time one unit of this resource is started up (UC resources only).
generators.storage_capacity_size_MWh: <float> Energy storage capacity per discrete unit in MWh (storage resources only).
generators.existing_storage_capacity_MWh: <float> Currently installed energy storage capacity in MWh (storage resources only).
generators.max_storage_capacity_MWh: <float> Maximum total energy storage capacity in MWh after investment (storage resources only).
generators.charge_efficiency: <float> Fraction of withdrawn energy that is stored when charging (storage resources only).
generators.discharge_efficiency: <float> Fraction of stored energy that is injected when discharging (storage resources only).
generators.self_discharge_rate: <float> Fraction of stored energy lost per hour due to self-discharge (storage resources only).
generators.min_duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Minimum ratio of energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW (storage resources only).
generators.max_duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Maximum ratio of energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW (storage resources only).
generators.inv_cost_energy_per_MWh_yr: <float> Annualized investment cost per MWh of new energy storage capacity (storage resources only).
generators.fom_cost_energy_per_MWh_yr: <float> Annual fixed operations and maintenance cost per MWh of total energy storage capacity (storage resources only).
generators.duration_MWh_per_MW: <float> Fixed ratio of reservoir energy capacity to power capacity in MWh per MW (hydro resources only).

transmission_lines.id: <int> Unique identifier for this transmission line.
transmission_lines.from_zone: <int> Zone at the sending end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines.to_zone: <int> Zone at the receiving end of the transmission line.
transmission_lines.existing_capacity_MW: <float> Currently installed transmission capacity in MW.
transmission_lines.max_new_capacity_MW: <float> Maximum additional transmission capacity in MW that may be built.
transmission_lines.inv_cost_per_MW_yr: <float> Annualized investment cost per MW of new transmission capacity.

demand.{zone_id}: <list[float], length total_timesteps> Hourly electricity demand in MWh for each zone, keyed by zone ID as a string.

nse_segments.segment: <int> Index of this non-served energy cost segment.
nse_segments.cost_per_MWh: <float> Penalty cost per MWh of demand curtailment in this segment.
nse_segments.max_frac: <float> Maximum fraction of zonal hourly demand that may go unserved in this segment.

{generator_id}.type: <str> Profile type: 'constant' for a fixed availability fraction or 'timeseries' for hourly-varying values.
{generator_id}.value: <float> Fixed availability fraction for all hours (present when type is 'constant').
{generator_id}.values: <list[float], length total_timesteps> Hourly availability fraction giving the maximum dispatchable share of installed capacity (present when type is 'timeseries').
